objectives.label: maintain artifact conformity to specification
objectives.description: Manufactured artifacts conform to the qualities their specifications prescribe.

objectives.label: prevent foreseeable harm to persons
objectives.description: Processes that affect persons do not carry uncontrolled safety-relevant dispositions.

objectives.label: satisfy institutional and regulatory obligations
objectives.description: Obligations attached to roles, quality systems and regulations are discharged.

objectives.label: preserve informed agency of affected persons
objectives.description: Parties with an interest in a process receive the information needed to act on it.

objectives.label: maintain reliable organizational decision information
objectives.description: Organizational decisions take the relevant records as input and close escalation loops.
